notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken green creature.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a nontoken green creature, adding {B}.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, putting the creature from your library onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
